blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — The five-peat-seeking University of the Visayas (UV) Green Lancers extended their winning streak to five games after outlasting the University of Southern Philippines Foundation (USPF) Panthers, 70-63, on Tuesday night, September 29, in the Cebu Schools Athletic Foundation Inc. (CESAFI) Season 26 collegiate basketball tournament at the Cebu Coliseum. UV has come a long way since its opening-game loss to the University of San Carlos (USC) Warriors, improving to 5-1 and tying the Warriors for the top spot in the team standings.
